domain_evidence.confirmed: Hosted start freezes an exact message and native SQLite admission compares the persisted message inside the transaction. Hosted continuation commits its native stage before status projection. Status runs current-provenance and exact-review checks and grants no authority.
confirmed_failures: The real provider changed 121/1000 seeded JSON timestamp bindings by one ULP. A wire-injected one-ULP change rejected message admission.
Ready status made 1083 real HTTP requests. Repeated JSON_VALID and read-only WITH queries cleared snapshot reuse; journey-current inspection had no encompassing read snapshot.
domain_evidence.inferred: Float decoding/binding precision and excessive round trips explain reproduced admission rejection and request-budget pressure. The exact transport cause of every historical generic RemoteUnavailable cannot be retrospectively recovered.
domain_evidence.authority: Original organization/request/inputs, native reservations, current account/stop evidence and lease-at-commit checks remain authoritative. No response, cached read or reconciliation result grants approval or dispatch.

fixes: Bind finite floats as exact integer significands and reconstruct REAL values using only power-of-two operations. Preserve placeholder identity and opaque SQL text. No decimal coercion or fact/timestamp rounding.

Use one read snapshot for journey-current provenance. Admit JSON_VALID and read-only WITH queries to the same bounded closed deterministic-read cache. CTE writes invalidate reuse. No cross-transaction memo or skipped validation.
Preserve safe adapter reason categories and optional numeric HTTP status through pipeline and uncertain-COMMIT wrapping. No submitted-request retry or raw provider text.

measurements.source_scope: Interim candidate-worktree probes, retained with helper/result hashes. The final full, boundary, cold-process and protected-preview gates below are separately bound to the final source commit.

ready_status.sampling: One before/after observation on the same ready journey, not a latency guarantee.

bounded_failure_space.precision: 134 fixed/seeded finite doubles compared to native SQLite with an independently injected one-ULP wire fault; plus 1000 timestamp and 261 finite-edge real-provider cases.
bounded_failure_space.identity: Numbered/repeated/anonymous slots, named/Tcl/Unicode names, quoted text/identifiers/comments and 11 namespace-edge forms; 2940 generated legal names also matched native SQLite.
bounded_failure_space.cache: Fresh cursors, exact bindings, writes and write-bearing CTE invalidation, new transaction/current state, volatile and quoted functions, clocks, capacity bounds and provider rollback before COMMIT.
bounded_failure_space.failure_categories: Redirect, HTTP429, pre-submit budget exhaustion, lost acknowledgement, inactive transaction and uncertain COMMIT retain no-repeat/no-dispatch behavior.
bounded_failure_space.recovery: Seven cold-process stages, original receipt replay, changed-input rejection, read-only status, unapproved readiness and five native offline boundary cases. This does not exhaust all distributed schedules.

retained_nonpassing_observations.result: Before fixes, admission rejected the drifted timestamp and ready status made 1080 wire requests. Float subtests also failed under injected drift.
First optimization left 930 status calls. A test also attempted named markers with positional bindings, which Python 3.14 forbids; that invalid oracle input was corrected.
Stopped for a counter-review correction after discovering native SQLite accepts leading/repeated/trailing Tcl namespace separators. No full pass is claimed for this attempt.

All seven stage responses and replays completed, but the old helper counted all historical runs in the shared native organization. A read-only check confirmed 18 global calls versus nine for the exact journey. Final helper counts only the exact journey run IDs/proposal and retains historical records.

limits: Earlier immutable evidence remains unchanged. Historical generic error causes cannot all be recovered.
No live model calls, paid fallback, new resource, production promotion, real outbound delivery or visitor access.
Preview uses the existing protected direct-acquisition-feasibility project in dub1 and existing acquisition-hosting-probe database.
No frontend changes; interface-check was not required. Broader tenant/load testing is not claimed.
